scope: Original session only. Main transcript lines 1-73 and every subagent transcript. The follow-up request (main transcript lines 74 onward, first timestamp 2026-10-13T07:38:59) and its work are excluded.
unknowns: The transcripts record 'effort' and 'perTurnEffort' as 'medium' on every assistant turn. They do not say whether this is the API-level effort parameter or a CLI default, and no effort-setting source is recorded.
The 'model' value is copied from the transcript record. It was not independently checked against API responses.
The transcripts do not record the system prompt, tool schemas, or thinking budgets sent with each request.
The subagent transcripts record no per-turn token usage in this audit; usage fields were not extracted.
Thinking blocks, signatures, account metadata, environment, and credentials were excluded by design and are not recorded.
The planner agent_type values come from the subagent .meta.json files. The Agent tool invocations in the main transcript were not inspected to confirm the subagent_type argument.
Hashes are of the on-disk files at collection time. The main transcript's full-file hash includes the excluded follow-up; use original_portion_sha256 for the audited portion.

Whether any original-session planner completion was delivered to the parent as a notification rather than read from the transcript is recorded only by the notification text in the main transcript; this audit does not verify delivery.
